answer: My answer to sybils is Allotted customs inspector certificate with customs service attestation — a certificate the service renews after border audits — which makes the juniper of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a certificate the service renews after border audits, and the umber grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the lagoon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
